jobs.title: Senior People Science Analyst (12 month FTC)
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . We re looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team for a 12-month fixed term contract. You ll specifically partner with customers across EMEA and North America on bespoke research using Culture Amp and customer-supplied data, owning studies from question through to action. GenAI tools will be part of that workflow, helping you work more efficiently, as you continue to identify further areas for improvement. As a thought leader in HR analytics, you ll combine data across diverse customers and use methods from psychology, economics and business to generate advanced insights into how employee experience shapes outcomes like turnover, sales performance and customer satisfaction. You ll surface trends for the HR community and make complex findings accessible through clear, engaging stories and practical strategies. The work is technical and customer-facing. You ll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public. You ll also help customers and colleagues build confidence with data. Because the team is small and the projects are complex, you ll have real ownership over which questions are worth answering and how they get answered. As part of this team of amazing humans, You will: Lead customer discovery and own studies end to end, from clarifying the business problem and shaping the research question through to design, delivery and recommendations Design, clean, combine and explore platform and customer-supplied datasets using robust, reusable approaches that protect participant privacy Conduct rigorous statistical analyses across engagement, lifecycle, performance and team effectiveness data, generating actionable and, where appropriate, predictive insights tied to business outcomes Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis and communication, while validating outputs, protecting customer data and maintaining methodological rigour Collaborate with customer-facing People Scientists on advanced HR analytics projects, applying sound judgment about methods, limitations and trade-offs Identify the themes and stories most likely to help organisations improve their culture and business outcomes, then communicate them through clear reports, presentations and internal and external thought leadership Create reusable methods, templates and assets; improve internal processes and practices; and negotiate scope, priorities and timelines to deliver high-quality work You have: An advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in organisational psychology, quantitative social science, economics or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience Applied experience using quantitative research methods on people or workforce data, idea

Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. We re moving from separate Sales and CX teams into integrated pods, each bringing together AEs, Account Managers, Customer Success Managers, and Renewals Managers to collectively own the full customer journey: land, adopt, expand, and renew. As the AE in your pod, you own the land motion. You ll be at the forefront of Culture Amp s growth in the commercial segment (up to 1,000 users), hunting new logos and setting up ambitious organizations to build a better world of work for their people, with a strong foundation for your pod s AMs and CSMs to build on. You ll bring a consultative, insight-led approach to fast-moving, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. You ll partner closely with SDRs and Marketing to build pipeline, and with your pod s AMs, CSMs, and Renewals Managers to set new customers up for a strong start, delivering a differentiated experience for commercial buyers and connecting their people challenges to measurable business outcomes. If you re deeply curious, commercially sharp, and energized by the challenge of winning in a competitive market, you re what we call a #peoplegeek and this role was built for you. You will Drive new logo acquisition across your commercial territory, owning the sales cycle from outbound prospecting through to close, and a clean handoff into your GTM Pod. Generate a significant portion of your own pipeline through proactive outbounding, using a combination of tools, tactics, and sales methodologies to break into target accounts. Build and manage a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce, maintaining consistent pipeline hygiene and weekly forecast updates. Run tailored product demonstrations and business case presentations for People Leaders and key stakeholders, clearly articulating Culture Amp s competitive differentiators and ROI. Build multi-threaded relationships across HR and key decision makers to drive consensus and accelerate deal velocity. Collaborate within your GTM Pod, SDRs, Marketing, Account Managers, CSMs, and Renewals Managers, to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience from first touch through to a strong start as a customer. Orchestrate pod members and broader internal partners you don t directly manage, setting new customers up for adoption and expansion from day one. Contribute to the broader Commercial team s craft, sharing learnings, participating in deal clinics, and helping raise the bar on how we sell. Strong outbound and self-sourcing capability, with experience building pipeline from scratch rather than relying on inbound alone. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . We re looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team on a 12-month fixed term contract. You ll specifically partner with customers across EMEA and North America on bespoke research using Culture Amp and customer-supplied data, owning studies from question through to action. GenAI tools will be part of that workflow, helping you work more efficiently, as you continue to identify further areas for improvement. As a thought leader in HR analytics, you ll combine data across diverse customers and use methods from psychology, economics and business to generate advanced insights into how employee experience shapes outcomes like turnover, sales performance and customer satisfaction. You ll surface trends for the HR community and make complex findings accessible through clear, engaging stories and practical strategies. The work is technical and customer-facing. You ll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public. You ll also help customers and colleagues build confidence with data. Because the team is small and the projects are complex, you ll have real ownership over which questions are worth answering and how they get answered. As part of this team of amazing humans, You will: Lead customer discovery and own studies end to end, from clarifying the business problem and shaping the research question through to design, delivery and recommendations Design, clean, combine and explore platform and customer-supplied datasets using robust, reusable approaches that protect participant privacy Conduct rigorous statistical analyses across engagement, lifecycle, performance and team effectiveness data, generating actionable and, where appropriate, predictive insights tied to business outcomes Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis and communication, while validating outputs, protecting customer data and maintaining methodological rigour Collaborate with customer-facing People Scientists on advanced HR analytics projects, applying sound judgment about methods, limitations and trade-offs Identify the themes and stories most likely to help organisations improve their culture and business outcomes, then communicate them through clear reports, presentations and internal and external thought leadership Create reusable methods, templates and assets; improve internal processes and practices; and negotiate scope, priorities and timelines to deliver high-quality work You have: An advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in organisational psychology, quantitative social science, economics or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience Applied experience using quantitative research methods on people or workforce data, ideal
